'''The Abyss''' was a smoking crater on [[Tinnel IV/Legends|Tinnel IV]], left after the capital city was completely destroyed by weapons of mass destruction during the [[Tinnel IV civil war]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=crewskill|Scavenging|Into the Abyss}}</ref>
